payload.claim: The diff raises REBUT's own rebuttal turn count from two to up to three (saffron/phases/rebut.py's run_rebuttal docstring now reads 'Three turns at most'), but ADR 0004's Consequences section still states 'The rebuttal is two turns, one to argue or fix and one to extract' with no 'Amended' note. This ADR has an established, repeated practice of amending exactly this paragraph for every prior REBUT turn/cost-shape change (see the 'Amended 2026-10-03, `SA-0203`', 'Amended 2026-10-07, `SA-0231`', and 'Amended 2026-10-20, `SA-0299`' lines at 70-85, all amending this same REBUT-shape area), so by the repo's own convention this diff needed a matching amendment and left the ADR's record of REBUT's turn shape wrong with nothing to catch it.
